scope: All 268 opinions in data/opinions.json. News and commentary were searched for the 115 opinions from federal courts of appeals, the U.S. Supreme Court and state supreme courts; press releases and Wikipedia articles were searched for all 268.
method: Each case was searched on the web and every linked page was read and confirmed to be about this decision: same parties, court and ruling, not an earlier or later one in the same dispute. Case-law databases, the opinion itself, filings and AI summary sites are excluded. Coverage of an original opinion is kept for its amended version. Copies of one decision under several CourtListener ids share their links. discusses_wayback is true only where the article itself discusses the Wayback Machine or Internet Archive in connection with the case. Press releases are statements about this decision issued by a party, counsel, an agency, an advocacy organization or the court itself; each is linked as a Wayback Machine capture dated on or after its release, checked to load and to name the case, with the live address in original_url. A release with no such capture is listed under press_releases.unverified, not linked. A Wikipedia article is linked only where its subject is this case and its court, date and citation match this opinion; where an opinion already had three links, it replaced the weakest one.
